## Earnie 2.5.3-alpha.3

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5.3** line (follow-up to `2.5.3-alpha.2`). Focus: Home Assistant add-on Phase 1 installation blockers (Supervisor HA discovery/auth).

### Highlights

- **Remove Loxone Supervisor options** — `loxone_user` / `loxone_pass` / `loxone_ip` dropped from add-on Configuration tab; credentials stay in-app / `config.json`
- **HA self-discovery via Supervisor** — `homeassistant_api: true`; probe `http://supervisor/core/api/` with `SUPERVISOR_TOKEN` before mDNS (`integrations/ha_supervisor.py`)
- **EHAL-HA without manual LLAT** — empty `ehal.ha.token` / URL resolve to Supervisor proxy in add-on context (token not persisted)
- Remaining Phase 1: Ingress + Options→`config.json` (Add-on 0.2)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.3-alpha.3` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.2**).
